notes.title: Release ver.1.01 Labyrinth of the Chaka King
notes.content:
When selecting a room by title and entering the room,
It was inconvenient because I could not see the screenshot of the room,
Improved to display a screenshot of the selected room.

It’s a little easier to play, so
Please aim for the Labyrinth Master of King Chaka.
